title: Organic part opener
description: Opens a part of the module: the part's number in a soft blob, then the opening's head (the part's large rounded title and its lead) and its page.
instructions: The first screen of a section, with the screen style part. number: the part's number (1, 2…), the only mark of where the learner is: nothing else goes above the title. The title names the part; lead says what it brings; the body holds one text block with the style meta (a few short facts).

number.title: Part number
number.description: The part's number, in a soft blob above the title (1, 2…).
